newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian junior government member quits.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian junior government member quits.

text.p: Senator Bob Woods, a junior member of the Australian government, said on Monday he was quitting parliament.
"I plan that this will be effective from March 1, 1997," Woods, the parliamentary secretary for health, said in a letter to Prime Minister John Howard.
Woods released a copy of the letter.
Another parliamentary secretary and an assistant minister quit the government last year.
Parliamentary secretaries are like junior ministers. Their duties include managing the passage of bills through parliament.

Woods was a senior figure in the Liberal-National coalition during its long years in opposition. He was the coalition's health spokesman before the 1993 election, in which he lost his seat in the House of Representatives, the lower house.
He later returned to parliament as a member of the Senate.
